     Ergot ; Spurred Rye. A Fungus.

     The alcoholic tincture is prepared from the fresh ergot, gathered shortly before harvest.

     This remedy awaits proving.

     Toxocological reports and effects of the rye disease are extensive. See Allen's Encyclopædia, vol. 8, p. 551.
